listed_sector_signals.signal: Cement industry grinding mills cited as an example of benchmarking/regression failure (not applied, just an illustrative example)
listed_sector_signals.quote:
the currently methodology used to estimate 
energetic efficiencies for large grinding mils in cement and 
mining industry by use of linear regression is relevant case of 
benchmarking uncertainty.

one_line: The paper proposes a Mathematical Model Benchmarking method and a unitless Benchmark Energy Factor for energy-efficiency rating of industrial systems, demonstrated via a case study on Industrial Refrigeration Systems (cold storage), with cement/mining grinding mills only mentioned as an example of regression-method failure.
